items.question: Trong câu "Agile is a mindset and a software development approach based on short iterations and continuous improvement driven by feedback — rather than planning everything upfront and only then building.", từ "mindset" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Agile is a mindset and a software development approach based on short iterations and continuous improvement driven by feedback — rather than planning everything upfront and only then building.", what does "mindset" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: mindset /ˈmaɪnd.set/ (danh từ): tư duy, lối nghĩ. "Agile is a mindset" = Agile là một lối tư duy, không chỉ là quy trình. Cụm: growth mindset (tư duy phát triển).
items.explanationEn: mindset /ˈmaɪnd.set/ (noun): a way of thinking. "Agile is a mindset" means it is a way of thinking, not just a process. Phrase: growth mindset.

items.question: Trong câu "Agile is a mindset and a software development approach based on short iterations and continuous improvement driven by feedback — rather than planning everything upfront and only then building.", từ "approach" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Agile is a mindset and a software development approach based on short iterations and continuous improvement driven by feedback — rather than planning everything upfront and only then building.", what does "approach" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a way of dealing with something
a road leading to a place
items.explanation: approach /əˈprəʊtʃ/ (danh từ): cách tiếp cận. "A development approach" = một cách tiếp cận phát triển phần mềm. Nghĩa khác: sự tiến lại gần.
items.explanationEn: approach /əˈprəʊtʃ/ (noun): a way of dealing with something. "A development approach" is a way of building software. Other sense: the act of coming nearer.

items.question: Trong câu "Agile is a mindset and a software development approach based on short iterations and continuous improvement driven by feedback — rather than planning everything upfront and only then building.", từ "based on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Agile is a mindset and a software development approach based on short iterations and continuous improvement driven by feedback — rather than planning everything upfront and only then building.", what does "based on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: based on /ˈbeɪst ɒn/ (cụm từ): dựa trên. "Based on short iterations" = dựa trên các vòng lặp ngắn. Nghĩa khác: be based in Hanoi = đặt trụ sở ở Hà Nội.
items.explanationEn: based on /ˈbeɪst ɒn/ (phrase): having as its foundation. "Based on short iterations" means built on them. Compare "based in Hanoi" = having its offices there.

items.question: Trong câu "Agile is a mindset and a software development approach based on short iterations and continuous improvement driven by feedback — rather than planning everything upfront and only then building.", từ "iteration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Agile is a mindset and a software development approach based on short iterations and continuous improvement driven by feedback — rather than planning everything upfront and only then building.", what does "iteration" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: iteration /ˌɪt.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): vòng lặp (phát triển). "Short iterations" = các vòng phát triển ngắn lặp lại. Động từ: iterate; tính từ: iterative.
items.explanationEn: iteration /ˌɪt.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (noun): one repeated cycle of work. "Short iterations" are short repeated cycles of work. Verb: iterate; adjective: iterative.

items.question: Trong câu "Agile is a mindset and a software development approach based on short iterations and continuous improvement driven by feedback — rather than planning everything upfront and only then building.", từ "continuous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Agile is a mindset and a software development approach based on short iterations and continuous improvement driven by feedback — rather than planning everything upfront and only then building.", what does "continuous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: continuous /kənˈtɪn.ju.əs/ (tính từ): liên tục. "Continuous improvement" = cải tiến liên tục. Cụm IT: continuous integration (CI).
items.explanationEn: continuous /kənˈtɪn.ju.əs/ (adjective): without stopping. "Continuous improvement" means improving without stopping. IT phrase: continuous integration (CI).

items.question: Trong câu "Agile is a mindset and a software development approach based on short iterations and continuous improvement driven by feedback — rather than planning everything upfront and only then building.", từ "improvement" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Agile is a mindset and a software development approach based on short iterations and continuous improvement driven by feedback — rather than planning everything upfront and only then building.", what does "improvement" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: improvement /ɪmˈpruːv.mənt/ (danh từ): sự cải tiến. "Continuous improvement" = cải tiến liên tục sau mỗi vòng. Động từ: improve.
items.explanationEn: improvement /ɪmˈpruːv.mənt/ (noun): making something better. "Continuous improvement" means getting better after every cycle. Verb: improve.

items.question: Trong câu "Agile is a mindset and a software development approach based on short iterations and continuous improvement driven by feedback — rather than planning everything upfront and only then building.", từ "drive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Agile is a mindset and a software development approach based on short iterations and continuous improvement driven by feedback — rather than planning everything upfront and only then building.", what does "drive" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: drive /draɪv/ (động từ): thúc đẩy, dẫn dắt. "Driven by feedback" = được dẫn dắt bởi phản hồi. Nghĩa quen thuộc: lái xe. Cụm: data-driven.
items.explanationEn: drive /draɪv/ (verb): to push forward. "Driven by feedback" means guided and pushed by it. Familiar sense: to operate a car. Phrase: data-driven.

items.question: Trong câu "Agile is a mindset and a software development approach based on short iterations and continuous improvement driven by feedback — rather than planning everything upfront and only then building.", từ "feedback" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Agile is a mindset and a software development approach based on short iterations and continuous improvement driven by feedback — rather than planning everything upfront and only then building.", what does "feedback" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: feedback /ˈfiːd.bæk/ (danh từ): phản hồi, góp ý. "Driven by feedback" = dựa vào góp ý của người dùng. Nghĩa khác: tiếng rít khi micro gần loa.
items.explanationEn: feedback /ˈfiːd.bæk/ (noun): comments on work done. "Driven by feedback" means guided by users' comments. Other sense: a whistling noise from speakers.

items.question: Trong câu "Agile is a mindset and a software development approach based on short iterations and continuous improvement driven by feedback — rather than planning everything upfront and only then building.", từ "rather than" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Agile is a mindset and a software development approach based on short iterations and continuous improvement driven by feedback — rather than planning everything upfront and only then building.", what does "rather than" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: rather than /ˈrɑː.ðə ðæn/ (cụm từ): thay vì. "Rather than planning everything upfront" = thay vì lên kế hoạch mọi thứ từ đầu. Tương tự: instead of.
items.explanationEn: rather than /ˈrɑː.ðə ðæn/ (phrase): instead of. "Rather than planning everything upfront" means instead of doing that. Similar: instead of.

items.question: Trong câu "Agile is a mindset and a software development approach based on short iterations and continuous improvement driven by feedback — rather than planning everything upfront and only then building.", từ "upfront" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Agile is a mindset and a software development approach based on short iterations and continuous improvement driven by feedback — rather than planning everything upfront and only then building.", what does "upfront" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: upfront /ʌpˈfrʌnt/ (trạng từ): từ trước, ngay từ đầu. "Planning everything upfront" = lên kế hoạch hết từ đầu. Nghĩa khác (tính từ): thẳng thắn (be upfront about).
items.explanationEn: upfront /ʌpˈfrʌnt/ (adverb): in advance. "Planning everything upfront" means in advance. Other sense (adjective): honest, open.

items.question: Trong câu "Agile is a mindset and a software development approach based on short iterations and continuous improvement driven by feedback — rather than planning everything upfront and only then building.", từ "only then" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Agile is a mindset and a software development approach based on short iterations and continuous improvement driven by feedback — rather than planning everything upfront and only then building.", what does "only then" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: only then /ˈəʊn.li ðen/ (cụm từ): chỉ sau đó mới. "Only then building" = chỉ sau khi lên kế hoạch xong mới xây dựng — kiểu Waterfall.
items.explanationEn: only then /ˈəʊn.li ðen/ (phrase): not until that point. "Only then building" means building starts only after all planning is done — the Waterfall way.

items.question: Trong câu "Agile is not a fixed tool or process — it is a set of values and principles distilled in the Agile Manifesto (2001).", từ "fixed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Agile is not a fixed tool or process — it is a set of values and principles distilled in the Agile Manifesto (2001).", what does "fixed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: fixed /fɪkst/ (tính từ): cố định. "A fixed tool or process" = công cụ hay quy trình cố định. Nghĩa khác: đã được sửa (the bug is fixed).
items.explanationEn: fixed /fɪkst/ (adjective): not changing. "A fixed tool or process" is one that does not change. Other sense: repaired, as in "the bug is fixed".

items.question: Trong câu "Agile is not a fixed tool or process — it is a set of values and principles distilled in the Agile Manifesto (2001).", từ "process" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Agile is not a fixed tool or process — it is a set of values and principles distilled in the Agile Manifesto (2001).", what does "process" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: process /ˈprəʊ.ses/ (danh từ): quy trình. "A fixed tool or process" = công cụ hoặc quy trình cố định. Trong hệ điều hành, process còn là tiến trình đang chạy.
items.explanationEn: process /ˈprəʊ.ses/ (noun): a series of steps. "A fixed process" is a set series of steps. In operating systems, a process is a running program.

items.question: Trong câu "Agile is not a fixed tool or process — it is a set of values and principles distilled in the Agile Manifesto (2001).", từ "principle" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Agile is not a fixed tool or process — it is a set of values and principles distilled in the Agile Manifesto (2001).", what does "principle" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: principle /ˈprɪn.sə.pəl/ (danh từ): nguyên tắc. "Values and principles" = giá trị và nguyên tắc. Đừng nhầm với principal (hiệu trưởng, tiền gốc) — phát âm giống nhau.
items.explanationEn: principle /ˈprɪn.sə.pəl/ (noun): a basic rule or belief. "Values and principles" are beliefs and basic rules. Do not confuse with "principal" (head of school), which sounds the same.

items.question: Trong câu "Agile is not a fixed tool or process — it is a set of values and principles distilled in the Agile Manifesto (2001).", từ "distill" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Agile is not a fixed tool or process — it is a set of values and principles distilled in the Agile Manifesto (2001).", what does "distill" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to reduce to the key points
items.explanation: distill /dɪˈstɪl/ (động từ): đúc kết, chắt lọc. "Distilled in the Agile Manifesto" = được đúc kết trong Tuyên ngôn Agile. Nghĩa gốc: chưng cất rượu, nước.
items.explanationEn: distill /dɪˈstɪl/ (verb): to reduce to the key points. "Distilled in the Agile Manifesto" means summed up in its key points. Original sense: to purify a liquid.

items.question: Trong câu "We are uncovering better ways of developing software by doing it and helping others do it.", từ "uncover" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "We are uncovering better ways of developing software by doing it and helping others do it.", what does "uncover" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: uncover /ʌnˈkʌv.ər/ (động từ): khám phá ra. "Uncovering better ways" = đang khám phá ra những cách tốt hơn. Nghĩa gốc: mở nắp, lật tấm che.
items.explanationEn: uncover /ʌnˈkʌv.ər/ (verb): to discover. "Uncovering better ways" means discovering them. Original sense: to remove a cover.

items.question: Trong câu "Through this work we have come to value:", từ "come to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Through this work we have come to value:", what does "come to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: come to /ˈkʌm tuː/ (cụm từ): dần dần (nhận ra). "Come to value" = dần dần coi trọng. Cấu trúc: come to + động từ = dần dần làm gì. Nghĩa khác: tỉnh lại.
items.explanationEn: come to /ˈkʌm tuː/ (phrase): to gradually begin to. "Come to value" means to gradually start valuing. Pattern: come to + verb. Other sense: to regain consciousness.

items.question: Trong câu "the items on the right still have value, but the items on the left are valued more.", từ "value" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the items on the right still have value, but the items on the left are valued more.", what does "value" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: value /ˈvæl.juː/ (động từ): coi trọng. "Valued more" = được coi trọng hơn. Nghĩa khác: định giá (value a house). Danh từ: giá trị.
items.explanationEn: value /ˈvæl.juː/ (verb): to consider important. "Valued more" means considered more important. Other sense: to estimate the price of something.

items.question: Trong câu "the items on the right still have value, but the items on the left are valued more.", từ "item" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the items on the right still have value, but the items on the left are valued more.", what does "item" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: item /ˈaɪ.təm/ (danh từ): mục (trong danh sách). "The items on the right" = các mục ở cột phải. Nghĩa khác: món đồ, mặt hàng.
items.explanationEn: item /ˈaɪ.təm/ (noun): one entry in a list. "The items on the right" are the entries in the right column. Other sense: a product or thing.

items.question: Trong câu "Sequential (one phase after another)", từ "sequential" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sequential (one phase after another)", what does "sequential" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sequential /sɪˈkwen.ʃəl/ (tính từ): tuần tự. "Sequential" = làm tuần tự, xong bước này mới sang bước sau. Danh từ: sequence (chuỗi).
items.explanationEn: sequential /sɪˈkwen.ʃəl/ (adjective): in a fixed order. "Sequential" means one step after another. Noun: sequence.

items.question: Trong câu "Sequential (one phase after another)", từ "phase" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sequential (one phase after another)", what does "phase" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: phase /feɪz/ (danh từ): giai đoạn. "One phase after another" = hết giai đoạn này đến giai đoạn khác. Nghĩa khác: pha của mặt trăng.
items.explanationEn: phase /feɪz/ (noun): a stage in a process. "One phase after another" means stage by stage. Other sense: a shape of the moon.

items.question: Trong câu "Change is embraced", từ "embrace" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Change is embraced", what does "embrace" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: embrace /ɪmˈbreɪs/ (động từ): đón nhận. "Change is embraced" = sự thay đổi được chào đón. Nghĩa gốc: ôm chặt.
items.explanationEn: embrace /ɪmˈbreɪs/ (verb): to accept willingly. "Change is embraced" means change is welcomed. Original sense: to hug.

items.question: Trong câu "Early and frequent", từ "frequent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Early and frequent", what does "frequent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: frequent /ˈfriː.kwənt/ (tính từ): thường xuyên. "Early and frequent" feedback = phản hồi sớm và thường xuyên. Trạng từ: frequently.
items.explanationEn: frequent /ˈfriː.kwənt/ (adjective): happening often. "Early and frequent" feedback comes soon and often. Adverb: frequently.

items.question: Trong câu "Frequently changing requirements", từ "frequently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Frequently changing requirements", what does "frequently" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: frequently /ˈfriː.kwənt.li/ (trạng từ): thường xuyên. "Frequently changing requirements" = yêu cầu thay đổi thường xuyên — lúc đó Agile phù hợp.
items.explanationEn: frequently /ˈfriː.kwənt.li/ (adverb): often. "Frequently changing requirements" change often — that is when Agile fits best.

items.question: Trong câu "Requirements change constantly", từ "constantly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Requirements change constantly", what does "constantly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: constantly /ˈkɒn.stənt.li/ (trạng từ): liên tục. "Change constantly" = thay đổi liên tục. Lưu ý: tính từ "constant" còn nghĩa là không đổi (hằng số).
items.explanationEn: constantly /ˈkɒn.stənt.li/ (adverb): all the time. "Change constantly" means all the time. Note: the adjective "constant" can also mean unchanging.

items.question: Trong câu "Requirements change constantly — they cannot be "frozen" from the start.", từ "freeze" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Requirements change constantly — they cannot be "frozen" from the start.", what does "freeze" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to fix so it cannot change
items.explanation: freeze /friːz/ (động từ): đóng băng, chốt cố định. "Cannot be frozen" = không thể chốt cứng. Cụm: code freeze, scope freeze. Nghĩa gốc: làm đông đá.
items.explanationEn: freeze /friːz/ (verb): to fix so it cannot change. "Cannot be frozen" means cannot be locked. Phrases: code freeze, scope freeze. Original sense: to turn to ice.

items.question: Trong câu "Customers only see the final product — too late to make changes.", từ "final" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Customers only see the final product — too late to make changes.", what does "final" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: the last match of a contest
items.explanation: final /ˈfaɪ.nəl/ (tính từ): cuối cùng, hoàn chỉnh. "The final product" = sản phẩm hoàn chỉnh cuối cùng. Danh từ "final" = trận chung kết, kỳ thi cuối.
items.explanationEn: final /ˈfaɪ.nəl/ (adjective): at the end, finished. "The final product" is the finished one at the end. Noun "final" = the last match or exam.

items.question: Trong câu "The environment changes quickly (market, competitors, technology).", từ "environment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The environment changes quickly (market, competitors, technology).", what does "environment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: environment /ɪnˈvaɪ.rən.mənt/ (danh từ): bối cảnh (kinh doanh). "The environment changes quickly" = bối cảnh kinh doanh thay đổi nhanh. Nghĩa khác: môi trường tự nhiên, môi trường Dev/Production.
items.explanationEn: environment /ɪnˈvaɪ.rən.mənt/ (noun): the conditions around a business. "The environment changes quickly" means the business conditions. Other senses: nature, a Dev or Production setup.

items.question: Trong câu "The environment changes quickly (market, competitors, technology).", từ "competitor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The environment changes quickly (market, competitors, technology).", what does "competitor" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: competitor /kəmˈpet.ɪ.tər/ (danh từ): đối thủ cạnh tranh. "Competitors" = đối thủ cạnh tranh. Động từ: compete; danh từ: competition.
items.explanationEn: competitor /kəmˈpet.ɪ.tər/ (noun): a rival company. "Competitors" are rival companies. Verb: compete; noun: competition.

items.question: Trong câu "Software is hard to estimate accurately — you learn as you build.", từ "estimate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Software is hard to estimate accurately — you learn as you build.", what does "estimate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: estimate /ˈes.tɪ.meɪt/ (động từ): ước tính. "Hard to estimate" = khó ước tính (thời gian, công sức). Danh từ "estimate" /ˈes.tɪ.mət/.
items.explanationEn: estimate /ˈes.tɪ.meɪt/ (verb): to roughly calculate. "Hard to estimate" means hard to roughly calculate time or effort. Noun: estimate /ˈes.tɪ.mət/.

items.question: Trong câu "Software is hard to estimate accurately — you learn as you build.", từ "accurately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Software is hard to estimate accurately — you learn as you build.", what does "accurately" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: accurately /ˈæk.jə.rət.li/ (trạng từ): chính xác. "Estimate accurately" = ước tính chính xác. Tính từ: accurate; danh từ: accuracy.
items.explanationEn: accurately /ˈæk.jə.rət.li/ (adverb): correctly and exactly. "Estimate accurately" means without errors. Adjective: accurate; noun: accuracy.

items.question: Trong câu "Software is hard to estimate accurately — you learn as you build.", từ "as" (liên từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Software is hard to estimate accurately — you learn as you build.", what does "as" (conjunction) mean?
optionsEn: while, at the same time that
items.explanation: as /æz/ (liên từ): trong khi, đồng thời với. "You learn as you build" = bạn vừa làm vừa học. "As" còn nghĩa là: bởi vì, giống như.
items.explanationEn: as /æz/ (conjunction): while, at the same time that. "You learn as you build" means while you build. "As" can also mean because, or like.

items.question: Trong câu "Iterative: doing it over and over, improving with each cycle.", từ "iterative" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Iterative: doing it over and over, improving with each cycle.", what does "iterative" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: iterative /ˈɪt.ər.ə.tɪv/ (tính từ): lặp đi lặp lại. "Iterative" = lặp lại nhiều vòng, mỗi vòng tốt hơn. Khác "incremental" = thêm dần từng phần.
items.explanationEn: iterative /ˈɪt.ər.ə.tɪv/ (adjective): done again and again. "Iterative" means repeating cycles, each better than the last. Compare "incremental" = adding part by part.

items.question: Trong câu "Iterative: doing it over and over, improving with each cycle.", từ "over and over" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Iterative: doing it over and over, improving with each cycle.", what does "over and over" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: over and over /ˌəʊ.vər ənd ˈəʊ.vər/ (cụm từ): lặp đi lặp lại. "Doing it over and over" = làm đi làm lại nhiều lần. Tương tự: again and again, repeatedly.
items.explanationEn: over and over /ˌəʊ.vər ənd ˈəʊ.vər/ (phrase): again and again. "Doing it over and over" means again and again. Similar: repeatedly.

items.question: Trong câu "Iterative: doing it over and over, improving with each cycle.", từ "improve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Iterative: doing it over and over, improving with each cycle.", what does "improve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: improve /ɪmˈpruːv/ (động từ): cải thiện. "Improving with each cycle" = tốt hơn sau mỗi vòng. Đừng nhầm với improvise (ứng biến).
items.explanationEn: improve /ɪmˈpruːv/ (verb): to make better. "Improving with each cycle" means getting better every round. Do not confuse with "improvise".

items.question: Trong câu "Iterative: doing it over and over, improving with each cycle.", từ "cycle" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Iterative: doing it over and over, improving with each cycle.", what does "cycle" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: cycle /ˈsaɪ.kəl/ (danh từ): vòng, chu kỳ. "Each cycle" = mỗi chu kỳ (mỗi sprint). Nghĩa khác (động từ): đạp xe.
items.explanationEn: cycle /ˈsaɪ.kəl/ (noun): a repeated period of work. "Each cycle" is each repeated period, like a sprint. Other sense (verb): to ride a bicycle.

items.question: Trong câu "Incremental: adding new features with each cycle.", từ "incremental" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Incremental: adding new features with each cycle.", what does "incremental" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: incremental /ˌɪŋ.krəˈmen.təl/ (tính từ): tăng dần từng phần. "Incremental" = tăng dần, mỗi vòng thêm tính năng mới. Danh từ: increment (phần tăng thêm).
items.explanationEn: incremental /ˌɪŋ.krəˈmen.təl/ (adjective): growing step by step. "Incremental" means growing by adding a part each cycle. Noun: increment.

items.question: Trong câu "After sprint 1, there is already a usable product (even if incomplete) → the customer tries it, gives feedback → the next sprint is adjusted.", từ "usable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "After sprint 1, there is already a usable product (even if incomplete) → the customer tries it, gives feedback → the next sprint is adjusted.", what does "usable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: usable /ˈjuː.zə.bəl/ (tính từ): dùng được. "A usable product" = sản phẩm đã dùng được. Danh từ: usability (tính dễ dùng).
items.explanationEn: usable /ˈjuː.zə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be used. "A usable product" can already be used. Noun: usability.

items.question: Trong câu "After sprint 1, there is already a usable product (even if incomplete) → the customer tries it, gives feedback → the next sprint is adjusted.", từ "even if" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "After sprint 1, there is already a usable product (even if incomplete) → the customer tries it, gives feedback → the next sprint is adjusted.", what does "even if" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: even if /ˈiː.vən ɪf/ (cụm từ): dù cho. "Even if incomplete" = dù chưa hoàn chỉnh. Tương tự: even though (dù thực tế là).
items.explanationEn: even if /ˈiː.vən ɪf/ (phrase): regardless of whether. "Even if incomplete" means although it may not be complete. Similar: even though.

items.question: Trong câu "After sprint 1, there is already a usable product (even if incomplete) → the customer tries it, gives feedback → the next sprint is adjusted.", từ "incomplete" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "After sprint 1, there is already a usable product (even if incomplete) → the customer tries it, gives feedback → the next sprint is adjusted.", what does "incomplete" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: incomplete /ˌɪn.kəmˈpliːt/ (tính từ): chưa hoàn chỉnh. "Even if incomplete" = dù chưa đầy đủ. Tiền tố "in-" mang nghĩa phủ định.
items.explanationEn: incomplete /ˌɪn.kəmˈpliːt/ (adjective): not finished. "Even if incomplete" means not yet finished. The prefix "in-" means not.

items.question: Trong câu "After sprint 1, there is already a usable product (even if incomplete) → the customer tries it, gives feedback → the next sprint is adjusted.", từ "adjust" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "After sprint 1, there is already a usable product (even if incomplete) → the customer tries it, gives feedback → the next sprint is adjusted.", what does "adjust" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: adjust /əˈdʒʌst/ (động từ): điều chỉnh. "The next sprint is adjusted" = sprint sau được điều chỉnh theo phản hồi. Nghĩa khác: adjust to = thích nghi với.
items.explanationEn: adjust /əˈdʒʌst/ (verb): to change slightly. "The next sprint is adjusted" means changed a little based on feedback. Other sense: "adjust to" = get used to.

items.question: Trong câu "2-week sprints, clear roles", từ "role" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "2-week sprints, clear roles", what does "role" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a job or position in a team
items.explanation: role /rəʊl/ (danh từ): vai trò. "Clear roles" = vai trò rõ ràng (PO, Scrum Master, Dev). Nghĩa khác: vai diễn. Đừng nhầm với roll (cuộn).
items.explanationEn: role /rəʊl/ (noun): a job or position in a team. "Clear roles" are clear positions such as PO or Scrum Master. Other sense: a part in a film. Not "roll".

items.question: Trong câu "Visualize workflow, limit WIP", từ "visualize" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Visualize workflow, limit WIP", what does "visualize" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: visualize /ˈvɪʒ.u.ə.laɪz/ (động từ): trực quan hóa. "Visualize workflow" = thể hiện luồng công việc lên bảng cho dễ nhìn. Nghĩa khác: hình dung trong đầu.
items.explanationEn: visualize /ˈvɪʒ.u.ə.laɪz/ (verb): to show as a picture. "Visualize workflow" means to show the work on a board. Other sense: to picture something in your mind.

items.question: Trong câu "Agile at large enterprise scale", từ "scale" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Agile at large enterprise scale", what does "scale" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: scale /skeɪl/ (danh từ): quy mô. "At large enterprise scale" = ở quy mô doanh nghiệp lớn. Nghĩa khác: cái cân, vảy cá, thang đo.
items.explanationEn: scale /skeɪl/ (noun): the size or level. "At large enterprise scale" means at the size of a big company. Other senses: a weighing device, a fish scale.

items.question: Trong câu "Agile at large enterprise scale", từ "enterprise" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Agile at large enterprise scale", what does "enterprise" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: enterprise /ˈen.tə.praɪz/ (danh từ): doanh nghiệp. "Enterprise scale" = quy mô doanh nghiệp. Nghĩa khác: tính dám nghĩ dám làm (show enterprise).
items.explanationEn: enterprise /ˈen.tə.praɪz/ (noun): a business organization. "Enterprise scale" is the size of a large business. Other sense: boldness and initiative.

items.question: Trong câu "Ops, support, maintenance", từ "maintenance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Ops, support, maintenance", what does "maintenance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: maintenance /ˈmeɪn.tən.əns/ (danh từ): bảo trì. "Maintenance" = bảo trì hệ thống đang chạy. Nghĩa khác (BrE): tiền cấp dưỡng. Động từ: maintain.
items.explanationEn: maintenance /ˈmeɪn.tən.əns/ (noun): keeping something working. "Maintenance" is keeping a running system working. Other sense (BrE): money paid to support a child. Verb: maintain.

items.question: Trong câu "No planning → Agile has plans, but flexible ones.", từ "flexible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No planning → Agile has plans, but flexible ones.", what does "flexible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: flexible /ˈflek.sə.bəl/ (tính từ): linh hoạt. "Flexible plans" = kế hoạch linh hoạt, có thể đổi. Nghĩa gốc: dễ uốn. Danh từ: flexibility.
items.explanationEn: flexible /ˈflek.sə.bəl/ (adjective): able to change easily. "Flexible plans" can change easily. Original sense: easy to bend. Noun: flexibility.

items.question: Trong câu "No planning → Agile has plans, but flexible ones.", từ "planning" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No planning → Agile has plans, but flexible ones.", what does "planning" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: deciding in advance what to do
items.explanation: planning /ˈplæn.ɪŋ/ (danh từ): việc lập kế hoạch. "No planning" = không lập kế hoạch — một hiểu lầm về Agile. Nghĩa khác: town planning = quy hoạch đô thị.
items.explanationEn: planning /ˈplæn.ɪŋ/ (noun): deciding in advance what to do. "No planning" is a myth about Agile. Other sense: "town planning" = designing how a city grows.

items.question: Trong câu "No documentation → Agile has documentation, but just enough.", từ "documentation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No documentation → Agile has documentation, but just enough.", what does "documentation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: documentation /ˌdɒk.jə.menˈteɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): tài liệu. "Agile has documentation" = Agile vẫn có tài liệu. Đừng nhầm với documentary (phim tài liệu).
items.explanationEn: documentation /ˌdɒk.jə.menˈteɪ.ʃən/ (noun): written material explaining something. "Agile has documentation" means it still has written material. Not to be confused with "documentary".

items.question: Trong câu "No documentation → Agile has documentation, but just enough.", từ "just enough" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No documentation → Agile has documentation, but just enough.", what does "just enough" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: just enough /ˌdʒʌst ɪˈnʌf/ (cụm từ): vừa đủ. "Just enough" = vừa đủ dùng, không thừa. Agile tránh viết tài liệu quá dài không ai đọc.
items.explanationEn: just enough /ˌdʒʌst ɪˈnʌf/ (phrase): the right amount, no more. "Just enough" means the needed amount and no more; Agile avoids long documents nobody reads.

items.question: Trong câu "No deadlines → Agile has deadlines, but a flexible scope.", từ "deadline" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No deadlines → Agile has deadlines, but a flexible scope.", what does "deadline" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: deadline /ˈded.laɪn/ (danh từ): hạn chót. "Agile has deadlines" = Agile vẫn có hạn chót. Cụm: meet a deadline (kịp hạn), miss a deadline (trễ hạn).
items.explanationEn: deadline /ˈded.laɪn/ (noun): the latest time to finish. "Agile has deadlines" means there are still final dates. Phrases: meet / miss a deadline.

items.question: Trong câu "No deadlines → Agile has deadlines, but a flexible scope.", từ "scope" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No deadlines → Agile has deadlines, but a flexible scope.", what does "scope" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: scope /skəʊp/ (danh từ): phạm vi (công việc). "A flexible scope" = phạm vi công việc có thể đổi. Nghĩa khác: kính ngắm; "scope for" = cơ hội để.
items.explanationEn: scope /skəʊp/ (noun): the range of work included. "A flexible scope" means the included work can change. Other senses: a viewing tool; "scope for" = opportunity.

items.question: Trong câu "Winging it, just iterate and see → Agile needs clear goals.", từ "wing it" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Winging it, just iterate and see → Agile needs clear goals.", what does "wing it" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: wing it /ˈwɪŋ ɪt/ (cụm từ): làm bừa, tùy hứng. "Winging it" (thân mật) = làm đại, không chuẩn bị. Agile KHÔNG phải là làm tùy hứng.
items.explanationEn: wing it /ˈwɪŋ ɪt/ (phrase): to act without preparing. "Winging it" (informal) means acting with no preparation — Agile is not that.

items.question: Trong câu "Winging it, just iterate and see → Agile needs clear goals.", từ "iterate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Winging it, just iterate and see → Agile needs clear goals.", what does "iterate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: iterate /ˈɪt.ər.eɪt/ (động từ): lặp lại (để cải tiến). "Just iterate and see" = cứ lặp rồi xem sao — cách hiểu sai về Agile. Nghĩa khác: nói lại (reiterate).
items.explanationEn: iterate /ˈɪt.ər.eɪt/ (verb): to repeat to improve. "Just iterate and see" means repeating without a goal — a wrong view of Agile. Related: reiterate = say again.

items.question: Trong câu "Winging it, just iterate and see → Agile needs clear goals.", từ "goal" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Winging it, just iterate and see → Agile needs clear goals.", what does "goal" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: goal /ɡəʊl/ (danh từ): mục tiêu. "Clear goals" = mục tiêu rõ ràng (ví dụ Sprint Goal). Nghĩa khác: bàn thắng, khung thành.
items.explanationEn: goal /ɡəʊl/ (noun): an aim. "Clear goals" are clear aims, such as a Sprint Goal. Other senses in football: a scored point, the net.

items.question: Trong câu "individuals, working software, customer collaboration, responding to change.", từ "individual" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "individuals, working software, customer collaboration, responding to change.", what does "individual" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: individual /ˌɪn.dɪˈvɪdʒ.u.əl/ (danh từ): cá nhân, con người. "Individuals and interactions" = con người và sự tương tác quan trọng hơn quy trình. Tính từ: individual (riêng lẻ).
items.explanationEn: individual /ˌɪn.dɪˈvɪdʒ.u.əl/ (noun): a single person. "Individuals and interactions" means people matter more than processes. Adjective: individual (single, separate).

items.question: Trong câu "individuals, working software, customer collaboration, responding to change.", từ "collaboration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "individuals, working software, customer collaboration, responding to change.", what does "collaboration" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: collaboration /kəˌlæb.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự hợp tác. "Customer collaboration" = hợp tác với khách hàng, thay vì chỉ thương lượng hợp đồng. Động từ: collaborate.
items.explanationEn: collaboration /kəˌlæb.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (noun): working together. "Customer collaboration" means working with the customer rather than just negotiating a contract. Verb: collaborate.

items.question: Trong câu "individuals, working software, customer collaboration, responding to change.", từ "respond" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "individuals, working software, customer collaboration, responding to change.", what does "respond" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: respond /rɪˈspɒnd/ (động từ): phản ứng, đáp lại. "Responding to change" = phản ứng với thay đổi thay vì bám cứng kế hoạch. Nghĩa khác: trả lời (thư, câu hỏi).
items.explanationEn: respond /rɪˈspɒnd/ (verb): to react to. "Responding to change" means reacting to it instead of sticking to a plan. Other sense: to reply.

items.question: Trong câu "Waterfall: good when requirements are stable; Agile: good when requirements change.", từ "stable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Waterfall: good when requirements are stable; Agile: good when requirements change.", what does "stable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: stable /ˈsteɪ.bəl/ (tính từ): ổn định. "Requirements are stable" = yêu cầu ổn định, ít thay đổi — trường hợp Waterfall phù hợp.
items.explanationEn: stable /ˈsteɪ.bəl/ (adjective): not likely to change. "Requirements are stable" means they rarely change — when Waterfall works well.

items.question: Trong câu "the most popular frameworks today.", từ "framework" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the most popular frameworks today.", what does "framework" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: framework /ˈfreɪm.wɜːk/ (danh từ): khung phương pháp. "Agile frameworks" = các khung phương pháp làm việc như Scrum, Kanban. Nghĩa khác: khung kết cấu công trình.
items.explanationEn: framework /ˈfreɪm.wɜːk/ (noun): a structured way of working. "Agile frameworks" are structured ways of working like Scrum and Kanban. Other sense: a building's structure.
